hero.title: S3NK
hero.subtitle: Search Support Scout Navigation K9 (S3NK)
hero.tagline: Deploy Anywhere. Navigate Everything. Save Lives.

features.title: Adaptive Quadruped Locomotion
features.description: Navigate rubble, stairs, and extreme terrain with dynamic balance control. Four-legged stability where wheels fail.
features.detail: Self-stabilizing gait algorithms adapt in real-time to shifting surfaces and debris fields.

features.title: Intelligent Terrain Awareness
features.description: Multi-sensor fusion maps the unseen. LiDAR, depth cameras, and IMU data create a real-time 3D understanding of hostile terrain.
features.detail: 360° environmental scanning with obstacle classification and path optimization.

features.title: Real-Time Visual Surveillance
features.description: HD live-stream from the field. Day or night, S3NK provides persistent visual intelligence to rescue command.
features.detail: Low-latency video feed with night vision capability and automatic scene enhancement.

features.title: Environmental Hazard Detection
features.description: Gas leaks, toxic fumes, structural instability — S3NK identifies threats humans can't sense.
features.detail: Multi-spectrum environmental sensors trigger autonomous danger zone alerts.

features.title: Hybrid Control System
features.description: Seamlessly switch between autonomous navigation and direct operator control. AI handles the routine — humans decide the critical.
features.detail: Dual-mode operation with intelligent handoff and override capability.

features.title: Payload Delivery System
features.description: Medical supplies, communication devices, emergency tools — S3NK carries and deploys critical payloads where humans cannot reach.
features.detail: Modular payload bay with precision deployment and secure transport.

features.title: Live Data & Telemetry
features.tagline: Every Data Point. In Real Time.
features.description: Battery, position, sensor readings, mission status — a continuous stream of intelligence from the field to command.
features.detail: Telemetry dashboard with live metrics, historical data, and predictive analytics.

features.title: Modular Architecture
features.description: Swap sensors, arms, cameras, and payloads. S3NK adapts to the mission — not the other way around.
features.detail: Hot-swappable module system designed for field-level reconfiguration.

cta.headline: Ready to Deploy?
cta.subtext: S3NK is built for the missions that matter most.

footer.tagline: S3NK — Where machines go, so hope follows.
